notes.title: A Tribute to Independent Developers: Seeking Partners to Shape the Future
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147613/f8b846ad65926c99e9809a2461a21bb98285248b.jpg[/img]
[b]Dear Investors,[/b]

I am an independent game developer full of passion and dreams. Over the years, I have led small teams of 10 to 20 people, leveraging comprehensive technical skills and strong execution to complete multiple game projects. While those were not my independent games, my deep love for both games and technology has always driven me to embrace the latest advancements and strive to deliver creative and imaginative gaming experiences to every player.

With the release of this game, I am seeking the support of investors to help me build a dedicated team of passionate gamers and developers who can fully commit to this vision. That is the true purpose behind this game. I understand that creating a successful game is difficult for one person alone, which is why I am sincerely inviting like-minded investors to join me in exploring the future of the gaming industry together.

I firmly believe that the combination of technology and creativity can lead to extraordinary opportunities. If you are confident in the future of the gaming industry and wish to be a driving force for innovation, I warmly welcome you to reach out to me.

Thank you for your support of independent game developers. I look forward to our collaboration!
